clauses.reason: Terminated by Executive Order 12553, signed February 25, 1986, which orders that the listed Executive Orders, and any amendments thereto, are revoked, with no stated delayed effective date and no saving clause; the effective date is therefore the signing date, 1986-02-25. The table of revoked orders in the held text of Executive Order 12553 lists number 9949 with the subject "Amending provisions for transfer of personnel to certain public international organizations", and the same table lists Executive Order 9721, the order this one modified. This order modified paragraph 3(a) of Executive Order 9721 for one named employee, Paul D. Miles, so that his reemployment rights applied if his service with the International Frequency Registration Board ended without prejudice within five years of his transfer. Executive Order 10415 later struck the words "within five years from the date of his transfer to such Board" and inserted "on or before December 31, 1953"; that strike-and-insert amendment is a later event, not an end, and the clause continued, amended, until the express revocation. Executive Order 12553 also revokes amendments, so Executive Order 10415 is revoked with it.

research_rationale:
Identity: the held Federal Register text is Executive Order 9949 modifying Executive Order 9721 for Paul D. Miles (read in full). Inventory read and confirmed: one clause, the whole operative text. End: express revocation by Executive Order 12553 on 1986-02-25 naming the order by number. Whether Mr. Miles in fact transferred, and whether any reemployment right accrued, is not established by any held source and is not needed for the end, because the end rests on an express revocation, not on exhaustion; any accrued reemployment right is a surviving consequence that this claim does not assert or deny. Prior research: none reported. Searches: current-law:usc, current-law:ecfr, later-events:ofr_catalog, all complete with no coverage warning.

savings.reason: Executive Order 12553 has no saving clause. No held source shows that Mr. Miles transferred to the International Frequency Registration Board or acquired any reemployment right, so no accrued residual is established; if one exists it is a consequence of Executive Order 9721 paragraph 3(a) as modified, not a continuing command of this order.
